entity_ranked_evidence.title: COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi - Wikipedia
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: Ongoing COVID-19 viral pandemic in Delhi, India. The first case of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Indian capital of Delhi was reported on 2 March 2020. Delhi has the seventh-highest number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in India. On 22 March, Delhi observed a 14-hour voluntary public curfew (the Janata curfew) along with 75 districts in India, at the directive of the Prime Minister. More than 3000 people from a religious gathering in the Nizamuddin Markaz Mosque (in the Nizamuddin West area) were quarantined after suspicions that they had come in contact with infected people. See also: Timeline of the 2020 coronavirus pandemic in India. Major events of COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi in March. * The first case of COVID-19 in Delhi was confirmed on 2 March 2020 when a 45-year-old person from East Delhi, with a history of travel from Italy, tested positive for the coronavirus.
